overall: Friday in Los Angeles is expected to be a mild, somewhat marine-influenced day with patchy fog clearing by late morning and becoming partly sunny in the afternoon. Onshore south-southwest flow will keep temperatures moderate, with the NWS calling for a high near 70°F. Wind advisories are active for areas well east of LA (Imperial Valley and Yuma), but are not expected to directly impact the Los Angeles basin.
forecast_obs_notes: Model agreement is poor — GFS is a significant outlier at ~84.7°F while ECMWF (~72°F), HRRR (~74°F), NBM (~68°F), and Weather.com (~74°F) form a tighter cluster in the upper 60s to mid 70s. max_temp_prediction: The ensemble model (incorporating prior-day observations) expects a TMAX of 72.0°F, supported by ECMWF, HRRR, and Weather.com clustering in the 72–74°F range and NBM slightly cooler at ~68°F. However, the probability distribution is nearly flat across the 66–77°F range (~20% per bucket), yielding very high entropy (2.2) and a Tier 4 (Poor Signals — AVOID) classification for both even and odd bucket sets.
